scenario.sequence: Full 21 s cinematic transport, including 3.4 s retraction. Same normalized seven phase intervals and sampler motionTime as G3A. Restart through reset/play UI; 10 s warm-up then 30 s rAF sample.

protocol.fpsMethod: Percentiles of reciprocal visible requestAnimationFrame intervals.
protocol.comparison: G3A used a linear 18 s cycle. Hardware/viewport/network/warm-up/sample remain the same for desktop; pose residence time differs intentionally. These values must not be presented as identical motion workloads.
